name: Shirahane Suou
source:
A quiet, anxious, timid girl—
However, she is misunderstood; her beauty, which sets her apart from the herd, and her silence is seen as cool, and the timidity that prevents her from mixing with everyone is seen as independence.
Before she came to the academy, she went to live with her grandfather due to her family situation, and was homeschooled, therefore she is not good at interacting with people.
However, it is not because she hates people; her desire to make friends is double that of most people. Also, she is extremely shy, and this in combination with her anxiety means that she always blushes when she gets nervous. Because books and movies are her friends, she has a habit of quoting lines from books and movies in her conversations.
Her Amitie partners are [url=/c16862]Mayuri[/url] and [url=/c16863]Rikka[/url]. Her interests are literature, music, and film.

[From [url=http://flowersgame.com/]Jast USA[/url]]
